This 2021 Genesis GV80 3.5T Prestige arrives with 46,452 miles solidly in that sweet spot for a used luxury SUV where the original depreciation has already done the heavy lifting, yet plenty of life and reliability remain. Paired with an automatic transmission and full-time all-wheel drive, this GV80 delivers confident traction in a variety of conditions. AWD adds reassurance for those occasional mountain drives toward Big Bear or during rare Southern California rainstorms when grip matters most. The transmission shifts seamlessly, and the overall powertrain is tuned toward refinement this is a luxury SUV first, a performance vehicle second, and it strikes that balance beautifully.

The 3.5T Prestige is Genesis's highest configuration for the GV80, and it shows in every detail. The Prestige package also brings a head-up display, a 360-degree camera system, and an advanced driver assistance suite that includes lane-keeping assist, blind-spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, and rear cross-traffic alert.

Three rows of seating make the GV80 a practical choice for families in Riverside and across Riverside County who need real passenger capacity without giving up the luxury experience. Rear passengers are treated with generosity legroom and materials quality are both well above average for this segment. Ambient lighting, power-adjustable seats, and dual-zone climate control round out an interior that genuinely impresses.

This 2023 Genesis GV70 2.5T Select in striking Mauna Red represents a refined luxury crossover designed for discerning drivers who value sophistication and performance.

- Ventilated front seats with heated functionality
- Power folding ECM mirrors with Genesis logo lamp
- Power telescoping steering wheel with heating
- Power tilt and slide panoramic sunroof with one-touch open/close
- Integrated Memory System for driver seat, mirrors, and steering column
- Select Package with premium comfort upgrades
- Navigation system with Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration
- SiriusXM premium audio system with nine speakers
- Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment
- Automatic temperature control with dual zone air conditioning
- Rear parking sensors and exterior camera
- All-wheel drive with 2.5L turbocharged engine
- Reversible cargo tray and cargo cover included
- Tow hitch for added versatility
- 18-inch alloy wheels in real steel gray

The 2.5L turbocharged engine delivers responsive performance while the eight-speed automatic transmission with SHIFTRONIC ensures smooth acceleration and efficient highway cruising. All-wheel drive capability provides confidence in varied driving conditions, whether navigating city streets or venturing beyond. The GV70 achieves an EPA-estimated 22 city and 28 highway miles per gallon, balancing power with sensible fuel economy.

Comfort and convenience extend throughout the cabin. The Select Package elevates your experience with ventilated and heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and power-adjustable controls. The panoramic sunroof floods the interior with natural light, while the integrated memory system personalizes every drive by recalling your preferred seat, mirror, and steering wheel positions. Climate control zones allow driver and passenger independence in temperature preferences.

Technology integration keeps you connected seamlessly. The navigation system pairs with both Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, while the premium SiriusXM audio system with nine speakers delivers quality sound. Steering wheel controls put common functions within easy reach, and the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenient access. An emergency communication system provides peace of mind for your travels.

Safety receives thorough attention across multiple systems. Anti-lock braking with four-wheel disc brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag suite including front, side, knee, and overhead protection work together to protect occupants. The rear camera and parking sensors assist during low-speed maneuvers, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights respond to driving conditions automatically.

Practical amenities enhance daily use. The reversible cargo tray protects your cargo area floor, the cargo cover keeps items secure and out of sight, and the tow hitch expands capability for trailers or bike racks. A first aid kit ensures preparedness. The power liftgate provides convenient hands-free trunk access, particularly valuable when carrying groceries or luggage.

This GV70 Select combines the engineering excellence Genesis is known for with genuine utility. Every feature serves a purpose, whether advancing comfort, safety, or practicality. The low mileage ensures youre investing in years of dependable service. We invite you to schedule a time to experience this luxury crossover firsthand and discover why it represents an intelligent choice for your driving needs.
